create_IBOTDistillationHead: create an IBOTDistillationHead module for iBOT distillation with configurable MLP layers and normalization
build_IBOTDistillationHead_mlp: build an MLP backbone inside IBOTDistillationHead with configurable hidden dimensions and activation functions
run_IBOTDistillationHead_forward_local: run IBOTDistillationHead forward on local views producing only class token embeddings
run_IBOTDistillationHead_forward_global: run IBOTDistillationHead forward on global views producing both class and patch token embeddings
review_IBOTDistillationHead_init: review IBOTDistillationHead initialization with shared or separate head projections for class and patch tokens
